data.title: France v Italy 02/10/2026, Lineups - Flashscore.com
data.content:
Roberto Mancini’s second spell as Italy manager got back on track in style as the Azzurri dismantled Turkey to quickly erase the memory of their matchday one defeat to Belgium (2-0). Mancini will now be looking to build on Italy's strong UNL group stage record away from home, as their victory in Turkey was their fifth such consecutive win. There is still plenty of room for improvement though, as Italy have kept just one clean sheet in their last seven competitive games on their travels. [...] Life under Zinedine Zidane could hardly have started better for France, as they followed up their 1-0 triumph in Turkey with a late 1-0 win away to Belgium. Sitting top of Group A1 with two victories and two clean sheets, Les Bleus are well placed to progress beyond the group stage for the third time in the last four editions of the UNL. France could even eclipse their best-ever group-stage performance in this competition in 2020/21, a campaign in which they accumulated 16 points (W5, D1) [...] Michael Olise was the game-changer for France off the bench against Belgium, with seven of his last eight goals for club or country coming in the second half. For Italy, Francesco Esposito will look to build on the momentum gained from scoring against Turkey, with five of his last six goals for club or country arriving after the break.

Neither side seem to have any fresh absentees.
